name: business-central-mcp
description: Direct access to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central via its native WebSocket protocol.

bc_base_url.title: BC base URL
bc_base_url.description: On-prem URL (http://server/BC) or SaaS portal URL (https://businesscentral.dynamics.com/{tenant}/{environment}).

bc_username.title: BC username
bc_username.description: NavUserPassword username. Leave empty for SaaS / OAuth.

bc_password.title: BC password
bc_password.description: NavUserPassword password. Leave empty for SaaS / OAuth.

bc_client_id.title: Entra client ID
bc_client_id.description: Required for SaaS / OAuth. Application (client) ID of an Entra app with Dynamics 365 Business Central API permissions.

bc_client_secret.title: Entra client secret
bc_client_secret.description: Optional. When set, client-credentials (S2S) is used instead of device-code login.

bc_profile.title: BC profile
bc_profile.description: Optional profile id, e.g. BUSINESS MANAGER. Affects which Role Center loads and which pages Tell Me indexes.
